title: Negotiating and persuading / Neman da aiki da yin nishadi
bridge: A cikin yaren, don yin nishadi muna yin tsarin daidaitawa kamar 'ya kamata' ko 'ya kamata', da subjunctive a cikin wasu wasu da 'don haka'. A cikin turanci, B2 yana bukatan wasu tsarin da ba da dama ba kamar 'would', 'could', 'might' da 'I was wondering if...'. Yi tsammani ba tare da fasaha da 'hakanan' 'haka' 'haka' 'haka' 'haka' 'haka' 'haka' 'haka'. Wani abu mai muhimmanci shine cewa 'tag questions' kamar 'isn't it?' ba zai iya sauyawa da '¿no?' ba, saboda a turanci ya kamata ya dace da tsohuwar wasa mai taimako.
rule: Don neman da yin nishadi a turanci B2, ana yin amfani da: 1) Verbs modal don yin tsarin da ba da dama ba kamar 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Tsarin da yin tsami: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Tsarin don yin wahala: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Tsarin don samun hanyar farin ciki: 'What if we...?', 'How about...' + -ing, 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Conditional don nishadi: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (na biyu na conditional). Don yin nishadi, ana yin amfani da wasu kalmomin kamar 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...'. Mai muhimmanci: a turanci, 'suggest' da 'recommend' ya kamata ya dace da 'that + subject + verb a cikin form base (ba tare da 's'), ko da gerund: 'I suggest that we wait' / 'I suggest waiting'. Ba a yi amfani da subjunctive kamar a cikin yaren ba.

concept_examples.text: Could we possibly meet halfway on the price?
concept_examples.translation: Muna iya zama da juna cikin farashin farashin?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli miːt ˌhæfˈweɪ ɒn ðə praɪs/

concept_examples.text: I was wondering if you might consider a discount for bulk orders.
concept_examples.translation: Na tsamman ne in yarda in ganin ku ba da farashin mai yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju maɪt kənˈsɪdər ə dɪskaʊnt fɔː bʌlk ˈɔːrdərz/

concept_examples.text: What if we extend the deadline by a week? That could work for both of us.
concept_examples.translation: Yaya idan muka sanya sabuwar shekaru? Wannan zai iya aiki saboda dukkanmu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt ɪf wi ɪkˈstend ðə dedlaɪn baɪ ə wiːk ðæt kʊd wɜːrk fɔːr boʊθ əv ʌs/

concept_examples.text: If you agree to a lower price, we'll sign the contract today.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ku yarda da farashin mai yawa, muna sanya shi a cikin takardar a yau.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə loʊər praɪs wiːl saɪn ðə ˈkɒntrækt təˈdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: I suggest that we should wait until next week.
common_error.correct: I suggest that we wait until next week.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest waiting until next week.
common_error.explanation: Yin kuskure ne saboda ake amfani da tsarin yaren 'sugiero que debamos esperar' tare da 'should'. A turanci, bayan 'suggest' (da 'recommend', 'propose'), ya kamata a yi amfani da subjunctive na turanci, wanda shine tsarin da ba tare da 's' da ba tare da 'should'. Ana iya amfani da tsarin da gerund a matsayin fasali. Mai muhimmanci shine komai ya sani cewa subjunctive na yaren ba zai iya sauyawa da wani ba, a turanci ya kamata a yi amfani da form base saboda dukkan subjects, har ma 'he/she/it'.

levels.label: Softening requests and proposals
levels.translation: Yin tsarin da ba da dama ba da shawara

examples.original: Would it be possible to get an extension?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɒsəbl tə ɡet ən ɪkˈstenʃən/
examples.translation: Yaya zai zama mumkin in sami sabuwar shekaru?
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'would' a matsayin 'will' don yin tsami, kamar '¿Podría?' a cikin yaren.

examples.original: I was wondering if you could lower the price.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd ˈloʊər ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Na tsamman ne in yarda in sake farashin.
examples.note: Tsarin 'I was wondering if...' yana da muhimmanci a cikin shawarwari. Kadan a yi amfani da 'I wondered' wanda ya fi dacewa.

examples.original: Could we possibly agree on a different payment schedule?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli əˈɡriː ɒn ə ˈdɪfrənt ˈpeɪmənt ˈʃedjuːl/
examples.translation: Muna iya zama da juna cikin sabuwar shekaru mai yawa?
examples.note: 'Possibly' yana ba da yin tsami. A cikin yaren muna cewa '¿Podríamos quizás?', amma 'possibly' ya kamata a yi amfani da shi bayan subject.

examples.original: That's a fair point, but we can't go below ten percent.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə feər pɔɪnt bʌt wi kænt ɡəʊ bɪˈloʊ ten pəˈsent/
examples.translation: Wannan matsayi ya fi kyau, amma ba zan iya sake farashin da yawa ba.
examples.note: Bayan ganin matsayin wani (That's a fair point) shine matsayi mai muhimmanci kafin a yi wahala.

examples.original: If you agree to a longer contract, we could offer a better rate.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə ˈlɒŋɡər ˈkɒntrækt wi kʊd ˈɒfər ə ˈbetər reɪt/
examples.translation: Idan ku yarda da takardar mai tsawon sabuwar shekaru, zai iya ba da farashin mai kyau.
examples.note: Na biyu na conditional (if + past, would/could) ya kamata a yi amfani da shi don shawarwari masu yin wahala.

examples.original: How about reducing the quantity instead of the price?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ðə ˈkwɒntəti ɪnˈsted əv ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Yaya ake sake farashin da yawa a matsayin farashin?
examples.note: 'How about + -ing' shine tsarin mai kyau don nishadi.

levels.label: Persuading and reaching agreement
levels.translation: Yin nishadi da samun hanyar farin ciki

examples.original: Think of it this way: a lower upfront cost saves you money in the long run.
examples.phonetic: /θɪŋk əv ɪt ðɪs weɪ ə loʊər ʌpˈfrʌnt kɒst seɪvz ju ˈmʌni ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/
examples.translation: Duba haka: farashin da ya fi kyau ya taimaka mana a karkashin sabuwar shekaru.
examples.note: Tsarin 'Think of it this way' shine mai muhimmanci don canza nazari.

examples.original: Would you be open to a trial period for three months?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju bi ˈoʊpən tʊ ə ˈtraɪəl ˈpɪəriəd fɔː θriː mʌnθs/
examples.translation: Yaya za ku iya yarda da sabuwar shekaru mai tsawon wata uku?
examples.note: 'Open to' shine wasu kalmomin da ba da wani daidai a cikin yaren; yana nufin 'yarda da ganin'.

examples.original: If we meet your deadline, will you extend the payment terms?
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi miːt jɔːr dedlaɪn wɪl ju ɪkˈstend ðə ˈpeɪmənt tɜːmz/
examples.translation: Idan muna da sabuwar shekaru, zai iya nuna sabuwar shekaru mai kyau?
examples.note: Na farko na conditional (if + present, will) ya kamata a yi amfani da shi don shawarwari masu yin wahala da ke da asali.

examples.original: I'm confident we can find a solution that works for both sides.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈkɒnfɪdənt wi kæn faɪnd ə səˈluːʃən ðæt wɜːks fɔːr boʊθ saɪdz/
examples.translation: Ina tsamman ne cewa za mu iya samun wata hanyar da za a iya aiki saboda dukkanmu.
examples.note: Amfani da 'I'm confident' a matsayin 'I think' yana ba da tsada da yin nishadi.

translations.ha: Neman da aiki da yin nishadi

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / Bayar da kiyaye fahimta
bridge: A cikin Ingilishi, yana da kyau a matsayin 'I think' ko 'I believe' da kuma bayyana abin da ya sa a cikin ra'ayi daidai da 'because'. Amma don bayyana ra'ayi a cikin fahimta, ya kamata ka yi amfani da 'the reason being', 'due to', 'given that', da kuma yanayin yadda za a iya bayyana abin da zai faru ko 'if... then...'. Kad'a da yin nishadi na 'según mi opinión' (wato 'accordin to my opinion' - ba daidai ba, ya kamata a ce 'in my opinion'). Da yawa a cikin Ingilishi, 'would' da 'could' suna da muhimmanci sosai domin yin ra'ayi da kiyaye ra'ayi da kiyaye ra'ayi.
rule: Don bayyana ra'ayi a cikin fahimta a cikin Ingilishi, yi amfani da: 1) Yadda za a bayyana ra'ayi: 'In my view', 'From my perspective', 'I would argue that', 'It seems to me that'. 2) Bayyana dalilai: 'The reason for this is', 'This is due to', 'Given that', 'Considering that'. 3) Daidaito: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'While it is true that...', 'Nevertheless'. 4) Yanayin yadda za a iya bayyana abin da zai faru ko 'If... then', 'Unless...', 'Provided that...'. 5) Yanayin sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon

concept_examples.text: In my view, remote work has increased productivity, the reason being that employees avoid long commutes.
concept_examples.translation: A cikin ra'ayina, aiki daga gida ya kiyaye samun fasaha, dalilin shine masu aiki sun tsaya da yawa saboda basu iya motsa jirgin sama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, rɪˈmoʊt wɜːrk hæz ˈɪnkriːst ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti, ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˌemploʊˈiːz əˈvɔɪd lɔːŋ kəˈmjuːts/

concept_examples.text: I would argue that investing in education yields long-term benefits, given that it improves social mobility.
concept_examples.translation: Ina da ra'ayi cewa ba da kudi a makaranta ya samu fasaha a baya, saboda ya kiyaye halayen rayuwarsa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrgjuː ðæt ɪnˈvestɪŋ ɪn ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn jiːldz lɔːŋ tɜːrm ˈbenɪfɪts, ˈɡɪvn ðæt ɪt ɪmˈpruːvz ˈsoʊʃl moʊˈbɪləti/

concept_examples.text: From my perspective, the new policy is flawed, due to the fact that it ignores regional differences.
concept_examples.translation: A cikin ra'ayina, sabon tsarin siyasa yana da matsala, saboda ya tsaya da yawan rayuwar yankuna.
concept_examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspektɪv, ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz flɔːd, djuː tuː ðə fækt ðæt ɪt ɪɡˈnɔːrz ˈriːdʒənl ˈdɪfrənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: It seems to me that we should prioritize renewable energy, otherwise we will face severe climate consequences.
concept_examples.translation: Ya kamata mu nuna fatanin samun fasaha saboda ba zan iya tsaya da matsaloli na fasaha ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz tuː miː ðæt wiː ʃʊd praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈenərdʒi, ˈʌðəwaɪz wiː wɪl feɪs sɪˈvɪər ˈklaɪmət ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

common_error.wrong: According to my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct: In my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct_alt: From my point of view, the government should do more for education.
common_error.explanation: A cikin Espanyol muna cewa 'según mi opinión' (daidai da 'accordin to my opinion'), amma a cikin Ingilishi ba wannan kalma ba daidai ba; 'according to' yana da amfani da fasaha da dama (accordin to the report). Yadda za a ce daidai shine 'in my opinion' ko 'from my point of view'. Wannan matsala yana da matsala sosai ga masu magana da Espanyol saboda 'según' da 'according to' suna da wata irin wata.

examples.original: In my view, the film was overrated.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, ðə fɪlm wɒz ˌoʊvərˈreɪtɪd/
examples.translation: A cikin ra'ayina, wannan filin ya zama da matsala.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'in my view' don ra'ayi mai fasaha. Ko kuma 'to my mind' (a cikin ra'ayina) amma yana da fasaha mai yawa a Ingilishi.

examples.original: I strongly believe that recycling should be mandatory.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔːŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətɔːri/
examples.translation: Ina da tabbata cewa ba da kudi ya kamata ya zama daidai.
examples.note: 'Strongly believe' yana nuna ƙarfi; a cikin Espanyol muna cewa 'creo firmemente'.

examples.original: As far as I'm concerned, the project is on track.
examples.phonetic: /æz fɑːr æz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ɪz ɒn træk/
examples.translation: A cikin ra'ayina, wannan aikin yana da sabis.
examples.note: Wannan kalma ta fasaha domin nuna ra'ayinka na farko.

examples.original: The reason being that prices have risen significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈrɪzən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Dalilin shine yawan farashin ya yi girma.
examples.note: Ana yi amfani da comma bayan bayyana dalilin.

examples.original: Due to the lack of funding, the program was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /djuː tuː ðə læk ɒv ˈfʌndɪŋ, ðə ˈproʊɡræm wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.translation: Saboda rashin kudaden, sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon
examples.note: 'Due to' yana da fasaha da yawa a 'because of'. Yi tuni da 'to' kuma kada ka zuba 'because'.

examples.original: Given that the economy is unstable, we should be cautious.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn ðæt ði ɪˈkɒnəmi ɪz ʌnˈsteɪbl, wiː ʃʊd biː ˈkɔːʃəs/
examples.translation: Saboda yanayin kasa ya zama mai wahala, ya kamata mu nuna hasken kuskure.
examples.note: 'Given that' yana da fasaha domin nuna yadda za a iya bayyana yadda za a iya bayyana.

examples.original: While it is true that technology has drawbacks, it also opens up new possibilities.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ɪt ɪz truː ðæt tekˈnɒlədʒi hæz ˈdrɔːbæks, ɪt ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈoʊpənz ʌp nuː ˌpɒsəˈbɪlətiz/
examples.translation: Yaushe akwai matsala a cikin fasaha, amma har yanzu yana bawa sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon
examples.note: Wannan yanayi yana nuna daidaito tsakanin biyu.

examples.original: Unless we address climate change now, future generations will suffer.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles wiː əˈdres ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃnz wɪl ˈsʌfər/
examples.translation: Idan ba mu taimaka da canjin fasaha yanzu, sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'unless' kamar 'a matsakaici' (yanayin yadda za a iya bayyana).

examples.original: If the government invested more in healthcare, the overall well-being would improve.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt ɪnˈvestɪd mɔːr ɪn ˈhelθkeər, ði ˌoʊvərˈɔːl ˌwelˈbiːɪŋ wʊd ɪmˈpruːv/
examples.translation: Idan gwamnati ta ba da kudin da yawa a lafiya, sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon
examples.note: Yanayin na biyu na yadda za a iya bayyana abin da zai faru. A cikin Ingilishi, muna yi amfani da past simple a cikin 'if'.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Tsammanawa da yaushe
bridge: A cikin Turanci, don tsammanawa da yaushe muna yin amfani da 'would have + past participle' don sakamako, amma a Turanci na biyu na yin tsammanawa ta farko: 'had + past participle' a cikin matsayin shigarwa (third conditional). Wata kuskure ce da ke faruwa ne wata mutane suka yi 'if would have' saboda 'would' ba zai iya zama a cikin shigarwa ba. Kuma a Turanci akwai wasu nau'ikan 'might have' da 'could have' don nuna yuwuwar ko ƙwarewa, wanda a Turanci na biyu yana da wata irin wannan 'podría haber' ko 'quizás habría'.
rule: Don tsammanawa da yaushe a Turanci, muna yin amfani da 'third conditional' da wasu nau'ikan modal. Tsarin mai muni shine: 'If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle'. Misali: 'If I had studied, I would have passed'. Kuma muna yin amfani da modal: 'could have' (yuwuwa ko ƙwarewa), 'might have' (yuwuwa), 'should have' (shawara ko kuskure). A cikin magana da yaushe ko a cikin bayanin burin, muna yin amfani da 'wish + past perfect' (in sha Allah ya hada). 'Would have' ba zai iya zama a cikin shigarwa 'if' ba. A cikin tambayoyi, muna canza maza da 'would': 'Would you have...?'.

concept_examples.text: If I had known, I would have told you.
concept_examples.translation: Idan na san, zan ba ka ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn, aɪ wʊd hæv toʊld juː/

concept_examples.text: She might have missed the train.
concept_examples.translation: Ta iya yin rashin samun jirgin.

concept_examples.text: We could have won the match.
concept_examples.translation: Muna iya ganin mu kashe wasanni.

concept_examples.text: I wish I had studied more.
concept_examples.translation: In sha Allah na koyi da yaushe.

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Wannan kuskure yana faruwa saboda a Turanci na biyu muna yin amfani da 'Si hubiera sabido' kuma wasu dalibai suka yi 'hubiera' kamar 'would have', amma a Turanci shigarwa 'if' ba zai iya zama da 'would' ba. Ya kamata a yi amfani da 'had + participle' a cikin shigarwa. Don ƙare wannan, kuna iya tuna cewa 'would' kawai yana a cikin sakamako. Wata fasaha mai zurfi ita ce canza maza da 'had': 'Had I known...'.

examples.original: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the flight.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd lɛft ˈɜːrliər, ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə flaɪt/
examples.translation: Idan ta fita da yaushe, ba zai yi rashin samun jirgin ba.
examples.note: Tsarin daidai: 'If + past perfect, would not have + participle'.

examples.original: They would have arrived on time if the traffic hadn't been so bad.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wʊd hæv əˈraɪvd ɒn taɪm ɪf ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈhædnt biːn soʊ bæd/
examples.translation: Suna iya samun zuwa da yaushe idan rashin sa'a ba ya zama mai zurfi.
examples.note: La cláusula 'if' puede ir al final sin coma.

examples.original: You should have called me.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv kɔːld miː/
examples.translation: Ya kamata ka kira ni.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'should have' don nuna kuskure ko nuna ƙara.

examples.original: He could have been a doctor.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv biːn ə ˈdɒktər/
examples.translation: Ya iya zama likita.
examples.note: Nuna ƙwarewa ko yuwuwa da ba a samu ba.

examples.original: They might have forgotten the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Suna iya manta da taron.
examples.note: Nuna yuwuwa mai zurfi a cikin yaushe.

examples.original: I wish I had accepted the job offer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd əkˈsɛptɪd ðə dʒɒb ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: In sha Allah na yarda da wata aikin.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'wish + past perfect' don nuna ƙara.

examples.original: If only we had listened to the weather forecast.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈoʊnli wiː hæd ˈlɪsənd tuː ðə ˈwɛðər ˈfɔːrkæst/
examples.translation: In sha Allah mu ji fasalin yanayi.
examples.note: 'If only' wata fasaha mai zurfi da yuwuwa mai zurfi.
